headline: European live updates: Liverpool host Nottingham Forest at Anfield
description: Soccer matches kick off across Europe as Liverpool take on Nottingham Forest in the first Premier League match of the weekend.

headline: Michael Carrick keen to entertain as Man United look to bounce back against Ipswich
description: Michael Carrick wants to get back to winning games United host Ipswich at Old Trafford and look to bounce back from their opening weekend humiliation at Hull.

headline: Ipswich Town sign World Cup winner Exequiel Palacios from Bayer Leverkusen
description: Ipswich Town have announced the signing of World Cup-winner Exequiel Palacios from Bayer Leverkusen.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Could Julián Álvarez rejoin Man City?
description: Barcelona and Arsenal target Julián Álvarez is being lined up for a return to Manchester City. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Is Liverpool's No.1 transfer target Barcola the right Salah replacement?
description: Liverpool could spend up to €140 million in their deal for PSG winger Bradley Barcola, so is he the man to replace Mohamed Salah long term?

headline: Haaland and Cherki fire City to dominant win
description: Manchester City made light work of Crystal Palace, winning 4-1 with Erling Haaland and Rayan Cherki both scoring braces
